blocks.text: Amid his battle with cancer, comedian Ate Gay had a celebration of life through a “living funeral” attended by his family and friends. Ate Gay, whose real name is Gil Aducal Morales, gave a glimpse of the gathering held in Biñan, Laguna, through a series of posts on his Facebook page on Thursday, Oct. 15. Present at the wake-themed event were his fellow comedians Boobsie Wonderland and Jaka, Pegasus, and social media personality Arman Salon, who shared heartfelt messages in place of eulogies. “Celebration of Life.
